Title: VtESDB - An online responsive VtES database

Messages.Author: SmoiZ
Messages.Body:
Hi everyone!

I have decided to share my simple online VtES database with you guys.
The goal was to create a simple and fast experience with a modern looking interface. Its main use at this moment is as fast and easy card look-up. The site is compatible with modern smartphone browsers.

Current features:
- Searching
- Inventory
- Tagging/deck building

So feel free check it out at vtes.gartner.io.

For you developers out there here is a quick rundown.
The site is a web app written in NodeJS running Meteor. It currently is hosted on free servers which is why the app is suspended after prolonged inactivity. This adds an extra loading on the first request if the app is suspended.

I well come any feedback here but please redirect all feature requests / bug reports to: bitbucket.org/smoiz/vtesdb/

/smz
